answer: Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. Forging 328 of these means fabricating 328 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Proof comes from antarctic station winter over record: winters spent at one station across years of polar darkness. Watch the relic: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the terrace bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the raven audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
